```{r}
#| include: false
library(apaTables)
```

Body text before. `tbl-wide20` is the same shape of table the whole-branch
review measured live against `format: apaquarto-html`: wide enough (20
variables) that the automatic ladder would rotate-then-shrink it on a docx
render, so a render on THIS format is what proves the fix -- D37 measured
that HTML has no page, so nothing rotates and nothing shrinks, and the
ladder's own consequences must never reach an HTML render at all. (The
size-marker class name itself is deliberately not spelled out in this prose,
so a substring search for it downstream matches only a genuinely emitted
div, never this sentence.) `tbl-cap` and `apa-note` are both deliberately
absent, so the title and note reaching the output are the AUTOMATIC ones
(Task 7), proving the same automatic pipeline docx already has also reaches
HTML.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-wide20
#| echo: false
set.seed(1)
d20 <- as.data.frame(matrix(rnorm(30 * 20), ncol = 20))
names(d20) <- paste0("Var", 1:20)
apa.quarto.html(apa.cor.table(d20))
```
